verses.sloka: भरद्वाजाश्रमं दृष्ट्वा क्रोशादेव नरर्षभ: ।बलं सर्वमवस्थाप्य जगाम सह मन्त्रिभि: ॥ २.९०.१
verses.transliteration: bharadvājāśramaṁ dṛṣṭvā krośādeva nararṣabha: ।balaṁ sarvamavasthāpya jagāma saha mantribhi: ॥ 2.90.1

translations.english: Bharata, the knower of righteous ways and the best among men, saw the hermitage of Bharadwaja from a distance of one krosa and brought his entire army to a halt. He laid aside all his royal robes and weapons. Clad in silk garments, he went on foot along with his ministers, with the family priest Vasistha ahead of him.
translations.hindi: । अयोध्याकाण्ड का छियासीवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । न सप्ताशीतितमः सग; —::0: :— गुहस्य वचनं श्रत्वा भरतो भृशम प्रियस्‌ । घ्यानं जगाम तत्रेव यत्र! तच्छ तम प्रियम्‌

verses.sloka: पद्भ्यामेव हि धर्मज्ञो न्यस्तशस्त्रपरिच्छद: ।वसानो वाससी क्षौमे पुरोधाय पुरोधसम् ॥ २.९०.२
verses.transliteration: padbhyāmeva hi dharmajño nyastaśastraparicchada: ।vasāno vāsasī kṣaume purodhāya purodhasam ॥ 2.90.2

translations.english: Bharata, the knower of righteous ways and the best among men, saw the hermitage of Bharadwaja from a distance of one krosa and brought his entire army to a halt. He laid aside all his royal robes and weapons. Clad in silk garments, he went on foot along with his ministers, with the family priest Vasistha ahead of him.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सुकुमार, बड़ी भुजाओं बाले, केहरी के समान कंघे वाले, महाधैयबान्‌, कमलनयन, तरुण और मनोहर दशन बाले

verses.sloka: तत: सन्दर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघव: ।मन्त्रिणस्तानवस्थाप्य जगामानुपुरोहितम् ॥ २.९०.३
verses.transliteration: tata: sandarśane tasya bharadvājasya rāghava: ।mantriṇastānavasthāpya jagāmānupurohitam ॥ 2.90.3

translations.english: Then the scion of the Raghu race (Bharata) halted his ministers within sight of Bharadwaja's (hermitage) and went along following his priest Vasistha.
translations.hindi: भरत जी, जब दो घड़ी बाद सचेत हुए, तत्र बहुत उदास हो, हृदय में अंकुश खाए हाथी की तरह, अचानक मूर्छित हो, प्रथिवी पर गिर पड़े

verses.sloka: ऺवसिष्ठमथ दृष्ट्वैव भरद्वाजो महातपा: ।सञ्चचालासनात्तूर्णं शिष्यानर्ध्यमिति ब्रुवन् ॥ २.९०.४
verses.transliteration: ऺvasiṣṭhamatha dṛṣṭvaiva bharadvājo mahātapā: ।sañcacālāsanāttūrṇaṁ śiṣyānardhyamiti bruvan ॥ 2.90.4

translations.english: On seeing Vasistha, the great ascetic Bharadwaja immediately left his seat and said to his disciples, Bring offerings of water.
translations.hindi: गी भरत जी की ऐसी दशा देख, निरन्तर भरन जी के पास ह्ने वाले शत्रू प्र जी अत्यन्त दुखित एवं संज्ञाहीन हो, भरत जी के शरोर से लिपट कर, उच्चस्वर से विलाप करते हुए रोने लगे

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठसाहचर्य्यादिति भाव: ॥ २.९०.५
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhasāhacaryyāditi bhāva: ॥ 2.90.5

translations.english: After meeting Vasistha and greeted by Bharata, the radiant Bharadwaja could recognize he was the son of Dasaratha.

verses.sloka: ताभ्यामर्ध्यं च पाद्यं च दत्त्वा पश्चात् फलानि च ।आनुपूर्व्याच्च धर्मज्ञ: पप्रच्छ कुशलं कुले ॥ २.९०.६
verses.transliteration: tābhyāmardhyaṁ ca pādyaṁ ca dattvā paścāt phalāni ca ।ānupūrvyācca dharmajña: papraccha kuśalaṁ kule ॥ 2.90.6

translations.english: Offering them both in order arghya (welcomeoffering), water to wash their feet and fruits in accordance with the practice, he enquired Bharata about the welfare of the family.
translations.hindi: तब भरत जी की सब माताएं, जो उपवास करने के क १ जो उपवार [रण Ei से कृश क पति को मृत्यु होने से शोकातुर हो रही था, ( भरत जो को मूर्छित हुआ न ) उनके दौ व मू डन ) उनके पास दौडी हुई ताश्च तं पतित भूमौ रुदन्त्यः पय वारयन्‌ | कव्या *त्वनुसुत्यैन दुमनाः परिषस्तरजे

verses.sloka: अयोध्यायां बले कोशे मित्रेष्वपि च मन्त्रिषु ।जानन् दशरथं वृत्तं न राजानमुदाहरत् ॥ २.९०.७
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāyāṁ bale kośe mitreṣvapi ca mantriṣu ।jānan daśarathaṁ vṛttaṁ na rājānamudāharat ॥ 2.90.7

translations.english: He enquired about the welfare of Ayodhya, of the army, treasury, friends and the ministers. But knowingly did not mention about Dasaratha's wellbeing (the knew Dasaratha was dead).
translations.hindi: जा हश “ तदनन्तर पुत्रवत्सला एबं तपस्विनी कौसल्या, अपने निज गर्भजात पुत्र के ममान, भरत जी को अपने हृदय से लगा, शोकाकुल हो, रो गे कर पूँछने लगीं

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठो भरतश्चैनं पप्रच्छतुरनामयम् ।शरीरे ऽग्निषु वृक्षेषु शिष्येषु मृगपक्षिषु ॥ २.९०.८
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho bharataścainaṁ papracchaturanāmayam ।śarīre 'gniṣu vṛkṣeṣu śiṣyeṣu mṛgapakṣiṣu ॥ 2.90.8

translations.english: Vasistha and Bharata also enquired about his health and welfare of his sacred fires, his disciples, animals and birds and trees of the hermitage.

verses.sloka: तथेति तत्प्रतिज्ञाय भरद्वाजो महातपा: ।भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं राघवस्नेहबन्धनात् ॥ २.९०.९
verses.transliteration: tatheti tatpratijñāya bharadvājo mahātapā: ।bharataṁ pratyuvācedaṁ rāghavasnehabandhanāt ॥ 2.90.9

translations.english: Saying, all is well, the great ascetic Bharadwaja, out of his affection for Rama, said to Bharata:

verses.sloka: किमिहागमने कार्य्यं तव राज्यं प्रशासत: ।एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं नहि मे शुद्ध्यते मन: ॥ २.९०.१०
verses.transliteration: kimihāgamane kāryyaṁ tava rājyaṁ praśāsata: ।etadācakṣva me sarvaṁ nahi me śuddhyate mana: ॥ 2.90.10

translations.english: Why have you come here when you ought to be ruling the kingdom? Tell me everything about this. My mind is not clear in this matter.
translations.hindi: हे बेटा ! लक्ष्मण जी के बारे में तो तुमने कोई अप्रियः समाचार नहीं सुना ? अथवा मेरा एकमात्र पुत्र, जो खी सहित बन में गया है, उसके विषय में तो कोइ अमङ्गल समाचार नहीं सुना ?

verses.sloka: सुषुवे यममित्रघ्नं कौसल्या नन्दवर्द्धनम् ।भ्रात्रा सह सभार्यो यश्चिरं प्रव्राजितो वनम् ॥ २.९०.११
verses.transliteration: suṣuve yamamitraghnaṁ kausalyā nandavarddhanam ।bhrātrā saha sabhāryo yaściraṁ pravrājito vanam ॥ 2.90.11

translations.english: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?
translations.hindi: महायशस्वी भरत जी दो घड़ी बाद सचेत हुए । तब उन्होंने रुदन करती हुई कौसल्या को धीरज बंधाया और गुह से कहने लगे

verses.sloka: नियुक्त: स्त्रीनियुक्तेन पित्रा यो ऽसौ महायशा: ।वनवासी भवेतीह समा: किल चतुर्दश ॥ २.९०.१२
verses.transliteration: niyukta: strīniyuktena pitrā yo 'sau mahāyaśā: ।vanavāsī bhavetīha samā: kila caturdaśa ॥ 2.90.12

translations.english: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?
translations.hindi: हे गुह ! मेरे भाई श्रीराम ने रात कहाँ बिताई थी, उन्होंने भोजन क्या किया था और किस बिछोने पर वे सोए थे; सीता और लक्ष्मण कहाँ रहे थे ? तुम ये सब वृत्तान्त मुझसे कहो

verses.sloka: कच्चिन्न तस्यापापस्य पापं कर्तुमिहेच्छसि ।अकण्टकं भोक्तुमना राज्यं तस्यानुजस्य च ॥ २.९०.१३
verses.transliteration: kaccinna tasyāpāpasya pāpaṁ kartumihecchasi ।akaṇṭakaṁ bhoktumanā rājyaṁ tasyānujasya ca ॥ 2.90.13

translations.english: Rama, destroyer of enemies and enhancer of the delight of his mother Kausalya, has been banished to the forest for a long time along with his wife and brother. That illustrious one has been ordered by his father to live in the forest for fourteen years through the pursuasion of a woman. To enjoy the kingdom without obstacles do you intend to cause any harm to that irreproachable Rama and his brother?
translations.hindi: निषादृराज गुह ने, प्रसन्न हो, ( प्रसन्न इसलिए कि उसे श्रीराम जी के गुणगान करने का अबसर प्राप्त हुआ ) श्रीराम जैसे प्रिय और हितैषी अतिथि का जैसा सत्कार किआ था--सो कहा

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो भरद्वाजं भरत: प्रत्युवाच ह ।पर्य्यश्रुनयनो दु:खाद्वाचा संसज्जमानया ॥ २.९०.१४
verses.transliteration: evamukto bharadvājaṁ bharata: pratyuvāca ha ।paryyaśrunayano du:khādvācā saṁsajjamānayā ॥ 2.90.14

translations.english: At these words, Bharata, eyes filled with tears of grief, replied to Bharadwaja in a stumbling voice:
translations.hindi: दे भरत ! मैंने तरह तरह के अन्न, भक्ष्य और बहुत से फल मूल ला कर भोजन करने के लिए श्रीराम के आगे रखे थे

verses.sloka: हतो ऽस्मि यदि मामेवं भगवानपि मन्यते ।मत्तो न दोषमाशङ्के नैवं मामनुशाधि हि ॥ २.९०.१५
verses.transliteration: hato 'smi yadi māmevaṁ bhagavānapi manyate ।matto na doṣamāśaṅke naivaṁ māmanuśādhi hi ॥ 2.90.15

translations.english: When one so venerable like you too misunderstands me, I am gone. There is no danger for him from me. Do not rebuke me this way.

verses.sloka: न चैत दिष्टं माता मे यदवोचन्मदन्तरे ।नाहमेतेन तुष्टश्च न तद्वचनमाददे ॥ २.९०.१६
verses.transliteration: na caita diṣṭaṁ mātā me yadavocanmadantare ।nāhametena tuṣṭaśca na tadvacanamādade ॥ 2.90.16

translations.english: I do not approve of whatever my mother said in my absence. I am not happy with those words and I do not accept them.
translations.hindi: टिपपणी--किसी किसी टीकाकार का मत है कि, श्रीरामचन्द्र के उपवास करने का कारण तीर्थविधि का पालन था---्र्थात्‌ तीथ में जा कर प्रथम दिन उपवास करना चाहिए | इसी लिए उन्होने गुह की भेंट ग्रहण नहीं की थी । किन्तु आगे के श्लोक से यह अनुमान समर्थन नहीं होता । ] न ह्यस्माभिः प्रतिग्राह्य सखे देयं तु सवेदा । इति तेन वयं राजन्न? चुनीता महात्मना

verses.sloka: अहं तु तं नरव्याघ्रमुपयात: प्रसादक: ।प्रतिनेतुमयोध्यां च पादौ तस्याभिवन्दितुम् ॥ २.९०.१७
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tu taṁ naravyāghramupayāta: prasādaka: ।pratinetumayodhyāṁ ca pādau tasyābhivanditum ॥ 2.90.17

translations.english: I have come to worship the feet of Rama, the best of men and persuade him to return to Ayodhya.
translations.hindi: महामना श्रीराम, लक्ष्मण जी का लाया हुआ जल, सीता सहित पी कर, उस रात उपवास करके रह गए

verses.sloka: त्वं मामेवङ्गतं मत्वा प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।शंस मे भगवन् राम: क्व सम्प्रति महीपति: ॥ २.९०.१८
verses.transliteration: tvaṁ māmevaṅgataṁ matvā prasādaṁ kartumarhasi ।śaṁsa me bhagavan rāma: kva samprati mahīpati: ॥ 2.90.18

translations.english: O venerable one in consideration of the circumstances I am in, be kind to me and tell me the whereabouts of Rama, lord of the earth.
translations.hindi: अनुतीता-:प्न्त्युक्ता | ( शि० ) २ वाग्यत:-- नयतवाच: । ( गो० ) ३ सीतायारओपसन्ध्यायांव्यानजपादिकमरस्सव | (गो) ४ हिताः-समाहिताः | (गो[०) # पाठान्तर 'महायशः । तदनन्तर लक्ष्मण जी ने भी, जो जल बच रहा था, सो पी लआ तदनन्तर तीनों ने भौन श्रौर एकाम्रचित्त हो, सन्ध्याबन्दन किश्मा

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठादिभिर्ऋत्विग्भिर्याचितो भगवांस्तत: ।उवाच तं भरद्वाज: प्रसादाद्भरतं वच: ॥ २.९०.१९
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhādibhirṛtvigbhiryācito bhagavāṁstata: ।uvāca taṁ bharadvāja: prasādādbharataṁ vaca: ॥ 2.90.19

translations.english: Likewise besought by Vasistha and other priests, the venerable Bharadwaja was pleased to tell Bharata:

verses.sloka: त्वय्येतत्पुरुषव्याघ्र युक्तं राघववंशजे ।गुरुवृत्तिर्दमश्चैव साधूनां चानुयायिता ॥ २.९०.२०
verses.transliteration: tvayyetatpuruṣavyāghra yuktaṁ rāghavavaṁśaje ।guruvṛttirdamaścaiva sādhūnāṁ cānuyāyitā ॥ 2.90.20

translations.english: O best of men (Bharata) your conduct towards the preceptors, your selfrestraint and devotion to the virtuous are all in keeping with those born in the race of Raghu.

verses.sloka: जाने चैतन्मन:स्थं ते दृढीकरणमस्त्विति ।अपृच्छं त्वां तथात्यर्थं कीर्त्तिं समभिवर्द्धयन् ॥ २.९०.२१
verses.transliteration: jāne caitanmana:sthaṁ te dṛḍhīkaraṇamastviti ।apṛcchaṁ tvāṁ tathātyarthaṁ kīrttiṁ samabhivarddhayan ॥ 2.90.21

translations.english: I am aware of the feelings in your heart. Even then I enquired in order to confirm it and to further your fame.
translations.hindi: हे राजकुमार ! देखो यहाँ तो बह इंगुदी का पेड़ हे ऑर यह्वी बह तृणशय्या है। इसी पर उस रात म श्रीराम और सीता दोनों सोए थे

verses.sloka: जाने च रामं धर्म्मज्ञं ससीतं सहलक्ष्मणम् ।असौ वसति ते भ्राता चित्रकूटे महागिरौ ॥ २.९०.२२
verses.transliteration: jāne ca rāmaṁ dharmmajñaṁ sasītaṁ sahalakṣmaṇam ।asau vasati te bhrātā citrakūṭe mahāgirau ॥ 2.90.22

translations.english: I know your brother who is conversant with righteousness is living on Chitrakuta mountain with Sita and Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: उस रात में शत्रं कओ दमन करन वाले लक्ष्मण, तीर सं भरे दो तरकस बाँध, हार्थो में गोह्‌ के चमड़ क दस्तान पहिन और हाथ में रोदा चढा हुआ बड़ा धनुप ले, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को रखवाली के लिए उनकी तृणशय्या ( से कुछ दूर हट ) उसक चारो ओर घूम घूम कर पहरा देते रहे

verses.sloka: श्वस्तु गन्तासि तं देशं वसाद्य सह मन्त्रिभि: ।एतं मे कुरु सुप्राज्ञ कामं कामार्थकोविद ॥ २.९०.२३
verses.transliteration: śvastu gantāsi taṁ deśaṁ vasādya saha mantribhi: ।etaṁ me kuru suprājña kāmaṁ kāmārthakovida ॥ 2.90.23

translations.english: O supremely sagacious prince gifted with the knowledge of kama (desire) and artha (wealth), tomorrow you go, but to night stay here with your ministers and fulfil my desire.

verses.sloka: ततस्तथेत्येवमुदारदर्शन: प्रतीतरूपो भरतो ऽब्रवीद्वच: ।चकार बुद्धिं च तदा तदाश्रमे निशानिवासाय नराधिपात्मज: ॥ २.९०.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastathetyevamudāradarśana: pratītarūpo bharato 'bravīdvaca: ।cakāra buddhiṁ ca tadā tadāśrame niśānivāsāya narādhipātmaja: ॥ 2.90.24 ॥

translations.english: A man of liberal disposition, Bharata expressed his intention, saying, 'Be it so'. Then the prince made up him mind to spend the might in that hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninetieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
